answer: Every new agent identity must lock a ferrous bond of 50 units and hold exclusive control of a physical TPM for 24h before answering. Only then does it emit a unique ridge signal proving device ownership. Scaling to N fakes forces an attacker to purchase N separate devices and lock N*50 capital; correlated signals trigger joint slashing of all linked bonds. The linear hardware-plus-capital cost per fake cannot be parallelized or bulk-bought, so large sybil farms lose money versus single honest agents.
